title: Communication Dated 15.9.37 From The Netherlands

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3108.                                SHANGHAI,    21st  September  1937 .

Sir,

      I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter of the 19th instant, No.D.8087, regarding Miss
Nina Kousnetzoff, and to thank you for the information
contained therein.

                                          I have the honour to be,
                                                 Sir,
                                          Your obedient servant,

                                          Acting Consul-General.

The Deputy Commissioner,
   Crime & Special Branches,
      Shanghai Municipal Police,
            SHANGHAI.

September 19 37.

Acting Consul-General,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 3031, dated 15th September, 1937, and
to inform you that there is nothing in Municipal Police
records against Miss Nina Kousnetzoff.

Miss Kousnetzoff, Russian, was born on
February 19, 1906, at Vladivostock, where she was employed
by Messrs. Kunst & Albers from 1921 to 1930. She
arrived in Shanghai in July, 1930, and was employed for
over four years with Moller's Ltd., 120 Kiukiang Road,
as an office assistant. At present she holds a similar
position at Viloudaki & Co., 59 Peking Road. She is
registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee. Her
last known address is House 4, Passage 129, Avenue Haig
(Victory Terrace).

On September 14, 1937, Miss Kousnetzoff
obtained from the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau
Travelling Certificate No.715 to enable her to proceed to
Hongkong on a holiday trip.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches)

1937 年 9 月 19 日。

代理总领事，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下 1937 年 9 月 15 日第 3031 号来函，并告知阁下，在工部局警务处档案中，并无针对尼娜·库兹涅佐夫小姐的不良记录。

库兹涅佐夫小姐，俄国人，1906 年 2 月 19 日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock），1921 年至 1930 年间受雇于孔斯特与阿尔伯斯公司（Messrs. Kunst & Albers）。她于 1930 年 7 月抵达上海，并在九江路 120 号的马勒有限公司（Moller's Ltd.）担任办公室助理四年有余。目前，她在北京路 59 号的维卢达基公司（Viloudaki & Co.）担任类似职务。她已在俄国侨民委员会登记注册。其最后已知住址为海格路（胜利公寓）129 弄 4 号。

1937 年 9 月 14 日，库兹涅佐夫小姐从上海市政府警察局获得第 715 号旅行证，以便前往香港度假旅行。

谨致
敬礼，
您顺从的仆人，

〔此处转录不清〕

副总监
（刑事及特别科）

Section 1, Special Branch    **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date September 19, 19 37

Subject Communication dated 15-9-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-
General concerning Miss N.A. Kousnetzoff

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by C Crawford 20

Miss Nina Alexandrovna KOUSNETZOFF, Russian, was
born on February 19, 1906 at Vladivostok. She is reported to
have arrived in Shanghai in July, 1930 from Vladivostok. Where,
according to her own statement, she was employed with Messrs
Kunst & Albers from 1921 to 1930. In Shanghai she is known
to have been employed for over four years with Foller's Ltd.,
120 Kiujiang Road, as an office assistant and at present holds
a similar position at Viloudaki & Co., 59 Peking Road.

Miss Kousnetzoff is registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee and her last known address is House 4,
Passage 129 Avenue Haig ( Victory Terrace ).

On September 14, 1937 she obtained from the Shang-
hai City Government Police Bureau Travelling Certificate No 715
to enable her to proceed to Hongkong on a holiday trip.

Nothing detrimental is known by this office re-
garding Miss Kousnetzoff.

C. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（左侧手写批注：26/9 19/9）

D. C. ( Crime & Special Branches )

日期 1937 年 9 月 19 日

事由：荷兰总领事馆 1937 年 9 月 15 日关于 N.A. 库兹涅佐夫小姐的公函

由警探长普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）撰写。    由 C. Crawford 转呈 20

尼娜·亚历山德罗芙娜·库兹涅佐夫（Nina Alexandrovna KOUSNETZOFF）小姐，俄国人，1906 年 2 月 19 日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostok）。据报她于 1930 年 7 月从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。据其本人陈述，她于 1921 年至 1930 年间受雇于孔斯特与阿尔伯斯公司（Messrs Kunst & Albers）。在上海，已知她曾在九江路 120 号的福勒有限公司（Foller's Ltd.）担任办公室助理四年有余，目前在北京路 59 号的维卢达基公司（Viloudaki & Co.）担任类似职务。

库兹涅佐夫小姐已在俄国侨民委员会登记注册，其最后已知住址为海格路（胜利公寓）129 弄 4 号。

1937 年 9 月 14 日，她从上海市政府警察局获得第 715 号旅行证，以便前往香港度假旅行。

本处未掌握任何关于库兹涅佐夫小姐的不利信息。

C. 普罗科菲耶夫
警探长

（左侧手写批注：26/9 19/9）

副总监（刑事及特别科）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.3031.

SHANGHAI, 15th September 1937.
（印：No S.B.D. 8027 / Date 17 - 9 - 37）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr.K.F.Mulder, manager
of the Java Chira Trading Co., 150 Kiukieng Road, intends to leave
for Hongkong within a few days. Mr.Mulder is a Netherlands
subject, duly registered with this Consulate and intends to take
his fiancee Miss Nina KOUSNETZOFF with him.

Miss Kousnetzoff seems to be in possession of a Chinese
emigrant passport and Mr.Mulder has requested my assistance to
get a permission from the Hongkong authorities to allow Miss
Kousnetzoff to stay in Hongkong till Mr.Mulder will return to
Shanghai.

Mr.Mulder will hold himself responsible for all her
expenses.

Miss Kousnetzoff is employed with Messrs.Viloudaki & Co.
Fed.Inc.U.S.A., 59 Peking Road.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person from
a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Acting Consul-General.

（批注手写：Cop Recd / key）

The Deputy Commissioner,
Crime & Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批注手写：S.I. / D.R. / 17/9 / D.S.S. Grakelfain. / C 17/9）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第 3031 号。

上海，1937 年 9 月 15 日。
（印：No S.B.D. 8027 / 日期 17 - 9 - 37）

先生：

谨此告知阁下，九江路 150 号爪哇吉拉贸易公司（Java Chira Trading Co.）经理 K.F. 穆尔德尔（K.F. Mulder）先生拟于数日内前往香港。穆尔德尔先生为荷兰籍臣民，已在本总领事馆正式注册，并打算携其未婚妻尼娜·库兹涅佐夫（Nina KOUSNETZOFF）小姐同行。

库兹涅佐夫小姐似乎持有一本中国移民护照，穆尔德尔先生请求我协助获取香港当局的许可，允许库兹涅佐夫小姐在香港停留，直至穆尔德尔先生返回上海。

穆尔德尔先生将承担她的所有费用。

库兹涅佐夫小姐受雇于美国联邦股份有限公司旗下的维卢达基公司（Messrs. Viloudaki & Co. Fed. Inc. U.S.A.），地址为北京路 59 号。

如蒙阁下告知，从政治或道德角度而言，是否知悉此人有任何不良记录，我将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，
您顺从的仆人，

〔签名〕
代理总领事。

（批注手写：Cop Recd / key）

致：
副总监，
刑事及特别科，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批注手写：S.I. / D.R. / 17/9 / D.S.S. Grakelfain. / C 17/9）
